title: Maharashtra MLC polls: Blame game begins in Mahayuti as BJP points fingers at Shiv Sena for defeat
description: Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde said that the Shiv Sena had always abided by alliance dharma; CM Fadnavis shares stage with Shiv Sena (UBT) chief Uddhav Thackeray at a function sparking political buzz; BJP calls Sena ‘greedy’ while Sena blames BJP for unfair seat distribution in the polls
